title: HAND HYGIENE
narration: Hand hygiene is a key infection prevention measure in healthcare. Follow your facility's current hand hygiene guidance, including when to clean hands before and after patient contact. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene.
description: General nursing education. Consult WHO hand hygiene guidance and your facility policy. https://www.who.int/teams/integrated-health-services/infection-prevention-control/hand-hygiene

title: PATIENT ID CHECK
narration: Before medication administration or specimen collection, use at least two approved patient identifiers according to your facility policy. Do not use a room number as a patient identifier. Check local protocols.
description: General nursing education. Verify against your facility patient-identification policy.

title: SBAR HANDOVER
narration: SBAR stands for Situation, Background, Assessment, and Recommendation. It provides a structured way to communicate clinical concerns. Use it alongside your organization's escalation and handover policy.
description: General nursing education. Verify against your organization's handover policy.
